title: ComfyUI Portable Setup & Must-Have Custom Nodes Guide
excerpt: A battle-tested production guide to setting up a zero-bloat portable ComfyUI installation with essential custom nodes for VFX artists.
content:
### ComfyUI Portable with Custom Nodes

Download and extract latest release:
[https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/releases](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/releases)

#### Essential Production Nodes:
1. **Comfy Manager**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager comfyui-manager
```
2. **RGThree Tools** (Quality-of-life UI and node routing)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy.git
```
3. **Video Helper Suite (VHS)** (Essential for video generation & frame sequences)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite.git
```
4. **CrysTools** (GPU & RAM monitoring HUD inside ComfyUI)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/crystian/comfyui-crystools.git
```
5. **MTB & KJNodes** (Procedural math and advanced masking)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/melMass/comfy_mtb.git
git clone https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes.git
```
6. **Anything Everywhere** (Clean wireless node execution)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/chrisgoringe/cg-use-everywhere
```

title: Step-by-Step Installation of FaceFusion on Windows
excerpt: Complete installation walkthrough for FaceFusion next-generation face enhancement and swapping tool using isolated virtual environments.
content:
### Installing Portable FaceFusion on Windows

Follow these clean isolated steps:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/FaceFusion/FaceFusion.git
cd FaceFusion
python -m venv myenv
myenv\Scripts\activate
python install.py --onnxruntime cuda
```

Run the UI:
```bash
python facefusion.py run
```
